# Provider icons

These files identify the providers monitored by Ocelin. They are original vendor assets, copied without modifying geometry, color or proportions on September 17, 2026. They are not covered by Ocelin's MIT license. Their owners retain all rights; inclusion does not imply sponsorship or endorsement.

- `codex-dark.png` and `codex-light.png`: OpenAI's Codex Windows app, package `OpenAI.Codex` version `26.908.4834.0`. Original files: `assets/Square44x44Logo.targetsize-48_altform-unplated.png` and `assets/Square44x44Logo.targetsize-48_altform-lightunplated.png`. [Official product](https://openai.com/codex/) · [OpenAI brand guidelines](https://openai.com/brand/).
- `claude.svg`: Anthropic's official VS Code extension `anthropic.claude-code`, version `2.1.273`, file `resources/claude-logo.svg`. Copyright Anthropic PBC. [Official extension](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=anthropic.claude-code) · [Official brand assets](https://brandfolder.com/anthropic/).

Only the three named images are served through the desktop `/vendor/` allowlist. No external requests are needed at runtime.
